context:
Goal: every verdict that merges has an independent agent arguing back (your ask, 12:25 CST).
Problem (money): the audit found that no hook that calls a model has an independent agent arguing back. Only design review (two blind reviewers) and the mutation tests in CI are both blind and adversarial, and nothing reads a wrong allow. Options d and e add model calls on every plan or every guard PR.
Based on (measured): debate-coverage-audit, an Opus agent, 12:40 CST.
Based on (ruling): rules roles-each-layer-proves-once and roles-review-cap-three.
Departs from: main roles rules have no blind refuter, and the round-1 fix check runs on haiku — adds the picks you tick. Options a to c change role rules in CLAUDE.md, so they need your word.

options.gain: The reviewer judges the code, not the builder's story about it.
options.how: A reviewer's brief holds only the task, the diff and the rulings. It never holds the builder's report or an earlier verdict. A check holds this.
options.label: Blind reviewer brief

options.gain: A judge that starts allowing what it should refuse is caught before it merges.
options.how: A set of known allow and deny cases runs in CI whenever a judge's prompt or model changes.
options.label: Replay cases for each judge
options.lose: Model calls in CI only, when a judge changes.

options.gain: A stronger read on the changes that matter most for safety.
options.how: The fix check on a PR that changes a guard or check runs on sonnet, not haiku.
options.label: Guard fix check on sonnet
options.lose: A slightly more costly model for those fix checks.

options.gain: Weak plans are caught before anyone builds them.
options.how: A second Opus agent gets only the brief and the plan, and tries to prove the plan wrong.
options.label: Blind plan refuter
options.lose: One more Opus call per plan.

options.gain: Safety holes in guard changes are hunted on purpose.
options.how: On a guard or check PR, a second blind reviewer is asked to find an act that main refuses and this change allows.
options.label: Second blind reviewer on guard PRs
options.lose: One more call per review round.

title: Which ways of adding an independent agent that argues back should we adopt?
why: Recommended: a, b and c, which cost little, then d. e adds a call to every round of every guard PR.
